title: ClinVar somatic-oncogenicity holdout (rebuilt 2026-09-24), VICC rule arm
task: ONC (Oncogenic+Likely oncogenic) vs VUS detection; operating point points >= 6; AUROC over raw VICC points
why_rebuilt: clinvar_vicc.json (n=458) took gold = E-utilities search term; the [Oncogenicity Classification] qualifier does not restrict Benign / Likely benign / Uncertain significance to oncogenicity records, so those gold labels were mostly germline classifications.

rule_arm_config.config_description: Sensitivity S-a2: v2 with OP1/SBP1 from REVEL alone (Pejaver 2022 single calibrated tool recommendation).
evidence: CIViC exact-variant, functional evidence only (OS2/OS2_Moderate vs SBS2/SBS2_Moderate; snapshot genes)

retired_holdout_for_comparison.status: retired: BEN/VUS gold labels not oncogenicity classifications

vep.gnomad_rule: max(gnomADe AF, gnomADg AF) for the alt allele; 0.0 when no gnomAD record is co-located

provenance.bootstrap: percentile; proportions via src.eval.stats.bootstrap_ci (5000, seed 0); AUROC class-stratified (2000, seed 0)
